interpretation.plain_speak: A single targeted refresh did not save any arm over the full evaluation horizon, and it performed exactly like a sham refresh. The warning is real, but this particular one-shot correction is not enough to prevent eventual failure. The remaining useful question is whether it buys meaningful time before failure.
interpretation.north_star_question: First bounded correction attempt is negative for eventual survival; corrective value, if any, may be delay rather than prevention.
interpretation.next_stage: freeze the same trigger and interventions and measure time-to-loss shift versus baseline and sham, without repeated maintenance
